mapper.select: SELECT id, title, image, position, link_type, link_value, sort_order, status, browse_count, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM promotion_banner WHERE ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT id, title, image, position, link_type, link_value, sort_order, status, browse_count, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM promotion_banner WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO promotion_banner (title, image, position, link_type, link_value, sort_order, status, browse_count, is_deleted, create_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{image}, #{position}, #{linkType}, #{linkValue}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, 0, 0, #{createTime})
mapper.update:
UPDATE promotion_banner
title = #{title}, image = #{image}, position = #{position}, link_type = #{linkType}, link_value = #{linkValue}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime},
WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE promotion_banner SET browse_count = browse_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
